plan.notes: Official 4-year plan of study published in the Sam Houston State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.shsu.edu). Courses, credits, and semester placement transcribed verbatim from the catalog plan grid; catalog footnotes preserved as choice notes. Credit ranges resolved to the minimum (catalog totals are ranges).

courses.title: Component Area VIII
courses.choice_note: PSYC 1301 is recommended to satisfy the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area VIII (Social and Behavioral Sciences).

courses.title: Contemporary Biology
courses.choice_note: BIOL 1408 and BIOL 1436 are preferred to satisfy the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area III (Life and Physical Science) and the major. Substitute courses may be considered.

courses.title: Introduction to Foundations of Mathematics I
courses.choice_note: Students must take 9 hours of Mathematics which includes MATH 1384 and MATH 1385 as 6 of the 9 required hours. MATH 3381 is the preferred third Math. MATH 1384 satisfies the Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area II (Mathematics) and the major.
